# Instructions to Author the correct terminology in writing company names/abbreviations

1. If company names have multiple names or short codes, use only full names; avoid using only short codes for company names.
2. If there are some company names that are spelt differently in different places, please make sure names are properly spelt.
3. If errors are found between previously mentioned company names and those with data, make full corrections to the company names.
4. Do not remove the names of companies that are mentioned without their short code in data. Always write them out in full format.
